title: Sphere No. 1 · Chalk white
subtitle: Matte plaster in chalk white, mid grey and graphite, starter catalog
description: Sphere No. 1 is a single matte chalk white plaster sphere with a faintly chalky surface. Cast in matte plaster in chalk white, mid grey and graphite, it is a plain form with no function beyond holding its shape and its shadow, which is what makes it a fair stand-in for a product you have not added yet. It comes in three sizes: small at about 8 cm, medium at 12 cm and large at 18 cm across. Every piece in this catalog is photographed in the same light on the same neutral backdrop, so the storefront reads as one series in any theme. Part of the starter catalog: swap it for your own product from the panel whenever you are ready.
